pages.text: Hex Casting patterns are drawn on a six-direction grid. In this port, the Hex Focus and Pattern Scroll provide a safe first step: right-click to execute the selected action and sneak-right-click to cycle it.

pages.title: Hex Focus
pages.text: The Focus stores the selected action on its NBT. Its player casting stack is persisted through the Forge capability system.

pages.title: Pattern Scroll
pages.text: Scrolls expose the registered starter patterns as creative-tab variants. They are intentionally data-driven so more migrated actions can be added without changing the item.
